featured_reviews.name: Mohit Tibrewal
featured_reviews.review_text:
The swimming pool at Naval Colony, Kanjurmarg, operated under the Michael Phelps Swimming brand, charges a very high rate for the general public (non-Naval), which comes to around ₹600–₹800 per visit when calculated from their package rates.

While the premium pricing is justified in their advertisements by the claim of temperature-controlled water, the reality is different — the temperature control system has not been operational for the past two years. Based on discussions with regular users, the reason appears to be an unresolved dispute between the Navy and the Michael Phelps Swimming management regarding electricity bill payments. Unfortunately, there is no sign of this being resolved soon.

featured_reviews.review_text:
This review is only for those parent(s) who are from middle class background and who know basic swimming that was learnt from their parents or from a professional and who are expecting that their child would pick basic swimming in their 60 sessions of Michael Phelps at Sahar Plaza Andheri East.

I would not recommend this place and instead if you have a pool within your society take your kid there and teach swimming as it is not rocket science but only practice. I enrolled my six year old daughter on 05/11/2025 with expiry on July 5, 2026 for 60 sessions as you can see from the swimming card. I was told that first 12 sessions was making the kid comfortable in water, gliding in water and jumping into water without fear which my daughter did. In reality, she was doing this for 15 sessions till I took them to task and asked them when they would start teaching her swimming that only then did they began her swimming classes. My kid was happy in the pool and was picking swimming quite well with confidence till 18th March on the 28th session when the head coach asked me about renewal as there was an offer going on. I told the coach that my expiry was not due and I will do it at that time irrespective of the offer. After that on the 29th session, the instructor who was teaching my kid started behaving oddly with my kid. He would instead of focussing on her swimming, started holding her when she was swimming or when she was jumping in water. Suddenly, in that one day, my daughter told me that if she didn’t swim properly, she would drown. The next session, I again noticed the same behaviour in the instructor and I realized that the instructor was hitting the confidence of my daughter by holding her hand when she jumped in the water which was never done with her. That was the last session of my daughter with Michael Phelps and on that day I gave earful to the head coach and questioned how the instructor had undermined the confidence of my kid. I told the head coach that till date the instructor never held the hand of my daughter whenever she jumped into the water and why did he hold only her hand and not the hand of any other kids who had jumped in the water. On hindsight, I realized that since I did not commit a renewal when asked to do so, the coaches decided to slow the progress of learning swimming of my kid so that I would do another 60 sessions and what is worse is for greed of money they hit the confidence of my kid in water by instilling fear of drowning so much so that it took me another 8 sessions in the pool of my society to rectify this fear. I decided to forgo the remaining 30 sessions of my daughter as I don’t want to entrust her with teachers who instilled fear instead of positive learning and it takes a long time to unlearn that instilled fear.
Coming to my background, I learnt swimming from my mother in a local pond in 10 days and so did my husband. After that, I sharpened my swimming with breathing technique in 15 days by a trainer. All my instructors be it my mother or the trainer told me only one thing – Be free in water and water will always push you upwards and the moment you struggle you will sink, so just be free in water and feel the water. This was a positive learning that I got about swimming. This learning takes time but it is positive learning and helps in swimming. The moment you talk to a child about drowning, the child learns fear not swimming.

So for those parents who think that their kid will learn swimming here in 60 sessions, its not going to happen without a renewal at Michael Phelps. The techniques taught here are all good but when a kid’s confidence is hit, it is difficult. If you have the money, then honey Michael Phelps is for you.

featured_reviews.review_text:
I am sharing this review to give honest feedback about this swimming centre.

The teachers and reception staff are generally helpful and sincere. One teacher noticed that my child was losing confidence and adjusted the training, which we really appreciated.

However, there are some areas where improvement is needed, especially since many young children attend these classes.

1. Cold Weather Conditions
Since this is an outdoor pool, strong winds blow directly onto the students during monsoon and winter. It feels cold even for parents sitting outside, and it is difficult for children after they come out of the water. When we raised this concern, we did not receive clear solutions.

2. Temperature-Regulated Pool
The pool is said to be temperature regulated, which is one reason we enrolled. However, during winter we were told that the heater was not working and would be started later. The water remained quite cold, making it difficult for children to complete their sessions comfortably.

3. Communication
Most staff members are polite, but one or two people sometimes speak in a way that feels a bit rude. A more friendly tone would help parents feel more comfortable.

4. Pool Support
There are no support rods or bars along the pool walls for children to hold. These would be helpful for beginners.

5. Washroom Facilities
Many mothers come with young children, but there is only one shower in the female washroom. Because of this, some people have to leave without washing after swimming.

Overall, the teachers are good, but some improvements in facilities and planning would make the experience much better for children and parents.

featured_reviews.review_text:
November 2025 review

Pool is big and possibly olympic size. The pool has various depths starting from shallow end of 4 feet to over 15 feet depth. The pool is trifurcated into three areas, 1) Shallow end ,2) 2 Full length lanes( this reduces the width of the pool for the other 2) 3) Main pool area. Small lockers, shower rooms etc are available at no extra cost.

Membership process:
Full the details online in the website, be sure to upload aadhaar and pay the amount. For verification you will need aadhaar copy, printout of 2 receipts(one will become your id), original copy of doctors medical certificate stating you have no skin diseases or communicable diseases and are fit to swim, and three passport photos.They will take aadhaar copy, both receipt copies,the doctors medical certificate and photos. You will recive an SMS that registration is done and they will give you back one stamped receipt with your photo as your medical id. Laminate it or keep it in a ziplock bag.

Advantages:
1) Very friendly staff. They are extremely courteous and helpful in resolving pool queries and so on.
2) Very convenient timings. 6AM-12 noon (11-12 ladies only) and 5-10PM (5-6PM ladies only)
3) Pool is maintained very clean despite its public nature.

Disadvantages:
1) Nothing is provided, no soap, towels or paper.
2) You will need to bring your own locks, lockers are very small so make sure you buy a small lock.
3) Restrictions apply on swimwear , no full body suits for anyone and men can only wear swim shorts. No cotton shorts, etc allowed. If you come in morning you can buy swimming shorts, goggles and swim caps from the reception but it could be expensive.
4) Pool is extremely clorinated, and you can feel it in your teeth and hair. Be sure to brush and clean yourself as soon as your done with swimming. No shower doors for showers.
5) This is a public pool, which means a lot of people will be using it, this is understandable but can cause problems if your trying to swim laps as many kids/adults will crash your path. If this is the case stick to pool area 2).

Best time to swim would be 9-11 in the morning as a guy, most people are working and the sun is bright such that the pool isn't too cold.

Some coaches also appear uninterested and non-cooperative during sessions, which affects the overall learning experience.

There were also occasions where staff members appeared to consume tobacco products before or during sessions, which created an unpleasant environment due to strong odor and felt highly unprofessional around students and parents.

Communication is another challenge due to language barriers, and overall the atmosphere feels poorly managed for a place that represents such a reputed name.

I hope the management takes these concerns seriously and improves the hygiene, professionalism, discipline, and overall experience for students and parents.

featured_reviews.name: Mohammad Asif Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text: Had an amazing experience learning swimming with Coach Shubhankar Sir! 🏊‍♂️ His coaching style is super patient, motivating, and focused on technique. He pays attention to every detail and helps you overcome your fears in the water. Each session is fun, challenging, and confidence-boosting. Highly recommend him to anyone wanting to improve their swimming skills!

featured_reviews.name: Toufiq Sayed
featured_reviews.review_text:
I opted in for their swimming programme last year and had a good experience overall- very professional and friendly trainers.

However, I wish they'd structure the programme to start by teaching basic survival in water first, instead of directly starting with freestyle and other swimming techniques.

Because midway through the programme I started having neck pain which further led  to the discovery that I had a neck issue since birth but it was passive till my neck started getting engaged a lot as part of learning the swimming techniques.
So I had to stop before I could learn basic survival in water which was my primary goal of joining the programme.

featured_reviews.name: Punit Sahani
featured_reviews.review_text:
This club is situated in Chembur. Right opposite to The Ferns. Being a club it has memberships to offer and banquet facilities too.

I was here to conduct workshop for one of my clients. There are several rooms on in the basement and on the ground level where multiple trainings are happening parallely. Several recreational activities are conducted for kids and adults. The food is nice, the staff is very polite and helpful.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Thank you for taking the time to share your experience with us. We’re delighted to know that you found our facilities convenient for your workshop and appreciated the variety of activities we host for members and guests.

featured_reviews.name: Sanjay G Rane
featured_reviews.review_text: I attended a meeting at Kanjivaram hall. Nice ambiance and good arrangements.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Thank you for sharing your experience! We're delighted to hear you enjoyed the ambiance of our Kanjivaram Hall and appreciated the arrangements made for the meeting. Your kind words encourage us to continue delivering exceptional experiences. We look forward to welcoming you back to The Acres Club soon!

featured_reviews.name: sakshi mandavkar
featured_reviews.review_text: It's a good hotel with a pleasing infrastructure and a swimming pool inside. Although they must improve the banquet interior. And the reception service is too slow as I had asked for water which took them so long that they forgot later. Must surely improve on relationship management.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Thank you for sharing your detailed feedback. We’re glad you enjoyed our hotel’s infrastructure and swimming pool. We truly value your suggestions regarding the banquet interiors and reception service, and we’re sorry to hear about the delay in providing water. Your comments will be shared with our team to ensure prompt service and improved guest relationship management. We hope to have the opportunity to welcome you again and offer you an even better experience.

featured_reviews.name: Tanish Dalvi
featured_reviews.review_text:
Here’s a harsh but still believable review you can use:

Acers Club is honestly one of the biggest disappointments I’ve experienced. The membership is ridiculously overpriced for what you actually get. Almost every single activity inside costs extra, so after already paying for the membership, they still keep charging you for everything. Absolutely not worth the money.

The gym is poorly maintained, and the equipment feels outdated. The swimming pool is barely clean most of the time and nowhere near the “premium” experience they advertise. The management is careless, the service is terrible, and the overall atmosphere just feels cheap despite the high prices.

This place markets itself like a luxury club but delivers the complete opposite. Save your money and go literally anywhere else.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Thank you for sharing your detailed feedback regarding your experience at The Acres Club. We are truly sorry to hear that your experience did not meet your expectations. At the club, we strive to provide quality facilities, services, and a positive environment for all our members and guests, so it is disappointing to learn that you felt otherwise.

We understand your concerns regarding membership value, maintenance standards, cleanliness, and service experience. Feedback such as yours is taken seriously and helps us identify areas where improvements are needed. Please note that certain activities and facilities may have separate usage charges based on operational requirements, but we understand the importance of ensuring transparency and value for our members.

 We appreciate you taking the time to provide honest feedback and hope we will have an opportunity to improve your perception of the club in the future.

featured_reviews.name: Menaka Tourani
featured_reviews.review_text:
Acres Club is a private club situated in Chembur.
Great amenities, lovely swimming pool. Good food ! Lots for children to do.
They have a small banquet room and a huge lawn for weddings.
The restaurant and pub are also good . All occasions are celebrated here.
They also have musical nights and karaoke too.
Trust me being a member here has its plus points !
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: We are delighted that you are have informed a great time with us. Please continue to enjoy our hospitality with family and friends

featured_reviews.name: Mayur B
featured_reviews.review_text: It’s a good club overall, but I can only give it 3 stars instead of 4 because there is no baby feeding room. For such a posh club, there should at least be a small, dedicated feeding space. We struggled with our 4-month-old baby. We were even ready to pay the full-day room charges just for 20 minutes of feeding, but no rooms were available and there was no feeding facility.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
We’re glad to hear you find the club good overall, but we’re truly sorry for the inconvenience you faced with your little one. We understand how important a comfortable and private feeding space is for parents, especially with a 4-month-old, and we regret that we couldn’t support you better during your visit.

We are already reviewing this internally and will be exploring options to address the same to ensure a smoother experience for young families in the future.

Thank you once again for highlighting this — it helps us improve. We hope to welcome you back with a much more comfortable experience next time.

featured_reviews.review_text: This is one of the worst places in the world. I am a member. Seriously, as a member if you want to play tt, you have to pay 50₹. If you are a member, these basic amenities should be given. Bad food quality.dirty pool.rude staff.pls do not visit

featured_reviews.name: Harshali S
featured_reviews.review_text: The place is small but has decent water quality. Moderate changing facility. Good caches. Mostly visited by families. Safe for women. You might be asked to pay 1K extra by coach apart from membership fees which does not feel good to me but the coaches really pay good attention to individuals so one may find it worth. The membership forms are not available round the year. Since the pool size is small the forms are discontinued after certain limit is reached. So you might want to check before dropping to collect form. Provides one time visiting pass facility 150 Rs. But you need to submit a familiar members ID card at the counter as security. Current membership fees are approx 5800 Rs. For students it is around 3500 Rs.

featured_reviews.name: Mohd Nadeem Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text: This swimming pool is the property of Municipal corporation Mumbai. The pool is not an olympic size pool. The facility provided is very basic and the pool needs some urgent upgrades and repairs. The shallow side of the pool has many cracked tiles, so avoid walking in it, you can get cuts and bruises in this part of the pool. The staff is good including the life gaurds. They have a very good coach to teach the kids some finer points of swimming. If you live in and around Ghatkopar you can visit this pool on single entry pass. Annual memberships also available at a very reasonable rates. Have a good time.

featured_reviews.name: Karthik Nadar
featured_reviews.review_text: Belongs to Municipal and Lions club. Don't expect proper training and treatment, but still quality is good. People swimming will also guide you; something good. It's cheaper annually; 4.6k only.

featured_reviews.name: Sanjay Phadale
featured_reviews.review_text: Odeon swimming pool is a great place. The water is very clean, it has a shallow water area and a area that is very deep. There is also a kid pool. A great place for swimmers. This is my honest review as I go there regularly.

featured_reviews.name: Satvik Patel
featured_reviews.review_text: Cheapest swimming pool in ghatkopar. Students may avail discount. One has to be careful with sharp broken tiles. I have bled myself many times. Morning sessions are less crowded.

featured_reviews.name: Vijay Sawant
featured_reviews.review_text: This Swimming pool is well Maintained (i.e. neat & Clean water) by BMC. almost all People in pool are decent and helpful. Highly qualified instructor. Good size space and Depth for Swimming pool, bathrooms, locker and vehicle parking. Its worth to experience.

featured_reviews.name: Deepak Kachare
featured_reviews.review_text: One of the best swimming pools in the suburbs. Also has a party lawn and a a/c party hall. Hall has a capacity of around 80 people. Good catering service is available.
